construction_markdown:
### Certified Boolean-polynomial anchor

Let

\[
p(Z)=Z^{16}+Z^5+Z^3+Z^2+1,
\quad F=\mathbb F_2[Z]/(p),
\quad \alpha=Z\bmod p.
\]

Write every `z∈F` uniquely as `z=Σ_{r=0}^{15}z_r α^r`. Define

\[
A=\operatorname{span}_{\mathbb F_2}\{1,\alpha,\ldots,\alpha^{14}\},
\qquad Y=\mathbb F_2^{15},
\]

and

\[
H(z)_y=z_0+\sum_{r=1}^{15}z_r y_r.
\]

For `f∈F[X]` of degree at most 64, set

\[
C(f)_{(a,y)}=H(f(a))_y,
\qquad (a,y)\in A\times Y.
\]

The certified code is

\[
C_0=\{C(f):\deg f\le64\}.
\]

Rows are indexed by `(j,i)∈{0,…,64}×{0,…,15}` and equal `C(α^iX^j)`. Columns are indexed by `(a,y)` in increasing 15-bit coefficient order. Equivalently, column integer `c` has `a=c>>15` and `y=c mod 2^15`.

Each row is a Boolean polynomial in the 30 coordinate bits `(a_0,…,a_14,y_1,…,y_15)` of degree at most `popcount(j)+1≤7`; hence `C_0⊆RM(7,30)`.

### Explicit conditional frontier

The full trace family

\[
C_{69}=\left\{\left(b+\operatorname{Tr}\sum_{\substack{1\le j\le69\\j\text{ odd}}}a_jx^j\right)_{x\in\mathbb F_{2^{30}}}\right\}
\]

has a completely deterministic `1051×2^30` generator and exact dimension 1051. Its rows have Boolean degree at most six. It is not a leaderboard candidate because only distance `535756800` is currently proved, 65536 below the target.

distance_audit: The inner block weights are `wt(H(0))=0`, `wt(H(1))=32768`, and `wt(H(z))=16384` for every `z∉{0,1}`.

Every nonzero degree-at-most-64 polynomial has at most 64 zeros among the 32768 points of `A`. Thus every nonzero anchor word has weight at least `(32768−64)16384=D`. This covers nonconstant polynomials and all nonzero constants.

For exact attainment, the displayed subspace polynomial `L_U` has precisely 64 roots in `A`, and the functional mask `0x007b` proves `1∉L_U(A)`. Its other 32704 blocks are therefore balanced, giving weight exactly `D`.
For `C_69`, ordinary Artin–Schreier/Hasse–Weil gives `|S|≤68·2^15=2228224`, hence only `d≥2^29−34·2^15=535756800`. The required cap is `64·2^15=2097152`.
Because `C_69` contains the external constant row, target distance requires the absolute character-sum bound for every nonconstant phase; a one-sided sign choice cannot close the gap.
explicitness_audit: Both finite fields use fixed quotient polynomials and polynomial bases; no field search or unspecified isomorphism remains.
For `C_0`, every row, column, and entry is fixed by integer-indexed bit operations. The convention `0^0=1` is used in the `j=0` rows.

The Boolean-ANF degree bound follows constructively from linear Frobenius maps and the bilinearity of field multiplication. ANF coefficients could also be compiled symbolically from the fixed multiplication tensor.
The full anchor matrix contains exactly `1040·2^30=1116691496960` output bits and is streamed without storing the matrix.
A conservative straight-line implementation uses fewer than `65kn+10500` elementary bit operations and `O(log n)` working bits beyond the output stream.

The analogous trace-row evaluator gives every entry of the conditional `C_69` matrix by fixed degree-30 field exponentiation and 30-term absolute trace in polynomial time. Its explicitness is proved independently of its unresolved distance.
No random sampling, finite lookup, canonical exhaustive selector, conditional-expectation recursion, puncturing, shortening, or padding occurs in the certified anchor.
The workspace is read-only, so no proof or record was persisted and publication validation was not attempted.

generator_matrix.algorithm: Precompute the 16 bitmasks `α^i`. For rows `(j,i)` in lexicographic order, with `0≤j≤64` and `0≤i≤15`, loop over `a=0,…,32767`. Interpret `a` as `Σ_{r=0}^{14}a_rα^r`, compute `u=a^j` by binary exponentiation (`a^0=1`), and compute `z=α^iu` modulo `p`. Then loop over `y=0,…,32767`, write `y=Σ_{r=1}^{15}y_r2^{r-1}`, and emit `G[(j,i),(a,y)]=z_0+Σ_{r=1}^{15}z_ry_r`. This emits all rows `C(α^iX^j)` and every one of the `1040·2^30` entries in the prescribed order.
generator_matrix.runtime_bound: Fewer than `65kn+10500` elementary bit operations for `k=1040`, `n=2^30`; therefore `Θ(kn)=Θ(n)` for this fixed construction, and in particular `n^{O(1)}`.
generator_matrix.runtime_proof: A naive `F_{2^16}` multiplication uses at most 256 coefficient ANDs, 256 convolution XORs, and fewer than 188 tests/reduction XORs, so bound it by 700 bit operations. Binary exponentiation for `j≤64`, followed by multiplication by `α^i`, uses at most 14 field multiplications per `(row,a)`. Computing the affine bit, updating fixed-width counters, and writing it costs fewer than 64 bit operations per `y`. Thus `T≤15·700+k·2^15(14·700+64·2^15)<10500+65kn`. The algorithm stores only fixed 16-bit registers and `O(log n)`-bit counters. Since any full emitter must write `kn` bits, this is output-optimal up to a fixed factor.

obstructions: No proved Boolean-polynomial code of dimension above 1040 survives both the universal-distance and explicitness gates.
The explicit dimension-1051 degree-69 trace family misses the target by 65536 under the strongest currently established uniform bound.

The weighted-orbit dichotomy rules out treating a searched 50-dimensional degree-67/69 selector as an independent escape: an anchored improvement exists in that architecture exactly when the full 60-dimensional top layer is safe.
The fixed affine-inner RS anchor has no strict additive outer supercode meeting the target; its durable reciprocal-sum witness is `0x0990≠0`.
Natural affine outer rows and uncoupled pure `y`-quadratic rows explicitly destroy the anchor distance. The remaining quadratic graph ceiling is not constructive.
This audit is not a global upper bound on binary codes and does not exclude unrelated Boolean-polynomial architectures.

proof_markdown:
## Explicitness and parameter theorem

The code `C_0` defined above is a deterministic binary linear code with exact parameters

\[
[2^{30},1040,535822336]_2,
\]

and its complete generator matrix is emitted in output-optimal polynomial time. The explicit degree-69 trace family has exact dimension 1051, but its target distance remains conditional.

### Field certificate

Use little-endian bitmasks, so `Z=0x0002` and `p=0x1002d`. Repeated squaring modulo `p` gives

`0004,0010,0100,002d,0451,13d1,7c98,018a,4069,c41b,92d0,3dab,d4f8,ebd5,7f8d,0002`.

Thus `Z^(2^16)≡Z` and `Z^(2^8)−Z≡h=Z^8+Z^7+Z^3`. Euclidean division gives

\[
p=(Z^8+Z^7+Z^6+Z^5+Z^4+Z^2+1)h+(Z^2+1),
\]

\[
h=(Z^6+Z^5+Z^4+Z^3+Z^2+1)(Z^2+1)+1.
\]

Hence `gcd(p,Z^(2^8)−Z)=1`; Rabin's degree-16 criterion proves irreducibility.

### Linearity, length, and dimension

Evaluation and `H` are binary-linear. Evaluation of `H(z)` at zero and the fifteen unit vectors recovers all coefficients of `z`, so `H` is injective. The coordinate set has size

\[
|A||Y|=2^{15}2^{15}=2^{30}.
\]

The message space has binary dimension `65·16=1040`. If `C(f)=0`, injectivity of `H` makes `f` vanish at all 32768 elements of `A`. Since `deg f≤64`, this forces `f=0`; hence the encoder is injective and the code dimension is exactly 1040.

### Distance

The affine truth table `H(z)` has weight zero for `z=0`, weight 32768 for `z=1`, and weight 16384 otherwise. A nonzero polynomial of degree at most 64 has at most 64 zeros on `A`. Therefore every nonzero codeword has weight at least

\[
(32768-64)16384=535822336.
\]

For equality, put `U=span{1,α,…,α^5}`. Direct subspace-polynomial recursion gives

\[
L_U(X)=X^{64}+\mathtt{2e0c}X^{32}+\mathtt{71ee}X^{16}+\mathtt{d9a4}X^8+\mathtt{2198}X^4+\mathtt{c6ca}X^2+\mathtt{6115}X.
\]

Its values on `α^6,…,α^14` are

`e9f1,d1b4,e1cf,9bc6,ea9c,7d5e,f733,26c1,770d`.

The binary functional with mask `0x007b` vanishes on all nine values and is one on the field element 1. Since `L_U` is additive, these values span `L_U(A)`, so `1∉L_U(A)`. Thus `L_U` has exactly 64 zero blocks and 32704 balanced blocks, proving exact minimum distance `D`.

### Boolean-polynomial form

For `j=Σ_t j_t2^t`,

\[
a^j=\prod_{t:j_t=1}a^{2^t}.
\]

Each Frobenius map is binary-linear, and field multiplication is bilinear. Hence every coordinate of `α^ia^j` has Boolean degree at most `popcount(j)`. Applying `H` multiplies such coordinates by at most one `y` variable. Since `popcount(j)≤6` for `0≤j≤64`, every generator row has degree at most seven. This also gives a deterministic symbolic ANF compiler from the fixed field multiplication tensor.

### Full-matrix algorithm

The algorithm in `generator_matrix` emits exactly the evaluations of the message basis `{α^iX^j}`. The explicit operation count there proves deterministic runtime below `65kn+10500`, with no construction search and no omitted preprocessing. Thus the complete matrix meets the hard `n^{O(1)}` requirement.

### Degree-69 separation

Over the fixed accepted model `F_2[T]/(T^30+T+1)`, the constant row and rows `Tr(θ^ix^j)` for odd `j≤69` and `0≤i<30` give exactly `1+35·30=1051` rows. Hasse–Weil bounds every nonzero phase by `68·2^15<2^30`, which proves row independence and hence exact dimension. The same bound gives only distance `535756800`. Therefore the matrix and its explicitness are unconditional, but the target-distance statement is not. No `k>1040` leaderboard submission is made in this turn.

theorem_statement: The certified RS–affine Boolean-polynomial code has exact parameters `[1073741824,1040,535822336]_2`, lies in `RM(7,30)`, and its complete generator matrix is emitted deterministically in fewer than `65kn+10500` elementary bit operations.
